description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a ratio and a minimum FDE20 value for different training methods. The x-axis is labeled “Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE20 (←)” and has a linear scale ranging from 19.0 to 23.0, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0. The line representing “TrajICL” is blue, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 22.8 at a ratio of 0.0 and decreases to approximately 20.5 at a ratio of 1.0. The line representing “Head Tuning” is orange, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 22.2 at a ratio of 0.0 and increases to approximately 22.8 at a ratio of 1.0. The line representing “FT” is green, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 22.1 at a ratio of 0.0 and increases to approximately 21.8 at a ratio of 1.0. The line representing “LoRA 16” is purple, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 22.4 at a ratio of 0.0 and decreases to approximately 22.3 at a ratio of 1.0. The line representing “LoRA 64” is pink, uses circular markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 21.9 at a ratio of 0.0 and increases to approximately 20.8 at a ratio of 1.0.
